character: Massive south-facing glacier resort. 200km pistes, 53 lifts. Vénéon valley floor. Year-round skiing on Mont-de-Lans glacier (3,600m). Ice skating, swimming, ice diving, museum. Famous for bike park in summer.
activities_nearby: Mont-de-Lans glacier (year-round, 3,600m). Bike park (one of Europe's best). Ice diving. Ice rink, swimming, cinema, spa. Paragliding. Snowpark. 200km ski area.
